assertion.statement: For every positive integer N and the fixed integer C>16, choose a prime P with CN<P<2CN for the base-case cyclic embedding.
assertion.objects: Interval length N, fixed integer C>16, and cyclic modulus prime P.
assertion.hypotheses: N>=1 and C is a fixed integer greater than16; hence m=CN>1.
assertion.quantifiers: Every positive integer N, with C fixed before N.
assertion.parameter_range: All positive lengths, including small N.
assertion.uniformity: C remains fixed, so N/P is between1/(2C) and1/C.
assertion.constants: CN and2CN; no asymptotic exceptional range.
assertion.normalizations: Strict lower and upper inequalities. Even if the upper endpoint is written non-strict in an intermediate argument, 2m is composite for m>1.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No limit argument is required to omit small lengths. This prime existence does not itself imply the Gowers-norm inequality or forward bracket theorem.
assertion.limit_order: Fix C, choose P by the theorem with m=CN, then zero-extend and use the separately justified norm comparison.

use.reason: Exact explicit published input in the frozen local proof; local conclusions are derived separately.

supplier.statement: For every integer m>1 there is a prime p with m<p<2m.

publication.title: Beweis eines Satzes von Tschebyschef
publication.corrections: No correction invoked; m>1 excludes the upper endpoint because2m is composite.
